findings.title: firstName returns last name instead of first name
findings.body:
The function `firstName` returns `name.trim().split(' ')[1]` which is the second word (last name), not the first word (first name). For 'Ada Lovelace', it returns 'Lovelace' instead of 'Ada'.

The doc comment correctly says 'Returns the person's first name', but the implementation uses index [1] instead of [0].
findings.verified: Confirmed: split(' ')[1] returns the second element
